en.headline: Cats extra shows at Xiqu Centre run through Sunday
en.dek: Andrew Lloyd Webber’s musical ends its Hong Kong engagement on 13 September after added performances at the West Kowloon Grand Theatre.
body: The current Hong Kong run of Andrew Lloyd Webber’s musical Cats concludes on Sunday, 13 September, at the Grand Theatre of the Xiqu Centre in West Kowloon, after the producers added a final block of performances from 8 to 13 September.

West Kowloon lists evening shows at 7.30pm from Tuesday to Sunday and 2.30pm matinees on Saturday and Sunday. The production is performed in English with Chinese surtitles and lasts about two hours and 40 minutes, including a 20-minute interval.

Tickets for the final extra performances were released through Cityline from 6 August, with standard prices ranging from HK$388 to HK$1,288 depending on seat and whether the performance is classed as a peak or non-peak show. The venue is at the Xiqu Centre in the West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: 音樂劇《貓》西九戲曲中心加場演至周日
zh.dek: 安德魯勞伊韓伯原版製作於西九戲曲中心大劇院的香港站，終極加場至9月13日結束。
body: 安德魯勞伊韓伯音樂劇《貓》香港站將於9月13日（星期日）在西九文化區戲曲中心大劇院結束，主辦單位早前加開9月8至13日的終極場次。
西九公布，星期二至日晚上7時30分演出，星期六及日另設下午2時30分場。製作以英語演出並配中文字幕，全長約2小晈40分，包括20分鐘中場休息。
終極加場門票由8月6日起於Cityline發售，票價由388元至1,288元不等，視乎座位及是否繁忙時段場次。場地為西九文化區戲曲中心大劇院。
